notes: SPLICE SEVERED (research 2026-07-03): the export gives this man a FATHER born 48 years after him — John Henry Hohman (1880-1935) of Braddock, Allegheny Co. PA, a confirmed-unrelated Catholic family (All Saints Braddock cemetery), which also dragged Maurice 'Morris J.' Hohman (1847) & Elizabeth Huffman into the pedigree. That parent link is refuted and should be ignored; John Heinrich's real parents are UNKNOWN.

His placement as father of Frank/John Franklin Hohmann (1855 Philadelphia - 1898, m. Mary A. Crist) is supported independently of the export by naming practice — the son was remembered as 'John F.' (1948 obit) — and fits an 1850s German immigrant fathering a Philadelphia-born son in 1855. Wife: Anna Elizabetha Kohlhepp. Status: plausible; the decisive document is Franklin's 30 Jun 1898 NJ death certificate (NJ State Archives index, free to search in-browser; cert ~$10), which should name Franklin's parents.

No John Heinrich Hohmann b. 1832 found in WikiTree, FamilySearch public pages, or Find A Grave — the German parish of origin is unknown (no documented Hessen link; treat any imported German generations as lore until a church record ties him to a parish).
